sources.version: CGPM 3 Declaration 2; SI Brochure 9th edition current text
sources.update_semantics: conventional reference value; not an observational feed

sources.provider: Quarterly Journal of the Royal Meteorological Society
sources.product: Review of the vapour pressures of ice and supercooled water for atmospheric applications
sources.update_semantics: fixed published equations; changing parameterization is a method change

sources.product: Transcription of climate response in a two-layer energy-balance model
sources.update_semantics: fixed literature reference fixture; not a live estimate of Earth-system state

sources.provider: NOAA National Snow and Ice Data Center
units: fraction or percent depending on product
sources.license_or_access_constraints: public NOAA@NSIDC distribution; dataset citation required
sources.update_semantics: daily/monthly products are revised as the maintained dataset is updated; immutable experiment inputs require an accessed artifact digest and access date

sources.provider: NASA Langley Atmospheric Science Data Center
sources.product: CERES Energy Balanced and Filled TOA and Surface Monthly Means
sources.access: netCDF via NASA ASDC/Earthdata ordering, OPeNDAP or supported cloud access
sources.license_or_access_constraints: NASA public Earth science data; some ASDC direct/cloud access paths require Earthdata authentication
sources.update_semantics: ongoing climate data record; edition and downloaded artifact digest are part of experiment identity

sources.product: ERA5 hourly data on single levels from 1940 to present
sources.access: Copernicus Climate Data Store API and analysis-ready Zarr where available

sources.license_or_access_constraints: CC-BY; CDS terms must be accepted and API access requires CDS credentials
sources.update_semantics: daily-updated reanalysis; retrieval request plus returned artifact digest define immutable experiment input

sources.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
sources.access: NCEI HTTPS archive and Common Access Data/Search Service REST APIs

units: dataset-element-specific units with metadata and flags
sources.license_or_access_constraints: NOAA public data; source-specific restrictions and flags remain part of provenance

sources.license_or_access_constraints: use under provider terms and cite HadCRUT5

sources.provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

sources.license_or_access_constraints: NOAA public data; dataset citation required
sources.update_semantics: maintained climate data record; pin product selection, time/depth subset and downloaded artifact digest

usages.rationale: standard gravity is a conventional reference value, not a location-specific gravity observation; kernels that need spatial gravity must receive it explicitly

Rd, cp, Rv and 1000 hPa are conventional idealized-atmosphere defaults and are caller-overridable model references, not observational state; alternative composition or temperature-dependent properties belong in explicit model parameterization
the numeric coefficients are the published scientific formula itself; replacing them with a live data feed would change the method rather than improve provenance
these are pinned CMIP5 multimodel-mean reference parameters for a controlled two-layer model, not a claim to current observational calibration
the noise scales deliberately create a reproducible structural-identifiability control; real observing-system uncertainty is a separate dataset-backed experiment
equal costs are a negative/structural control and must not be relabeled as acquisition cost evidence
latent ranges, method settings and acceptance guards are fixture/method policy for a known-ground-truth synthetic experiment
history length, minimum samples and numerical degeneracy tolerance are estimator policy, not measured climate data
legacy stable/active/excessive bands are explicit policy only and must never be promoted as empirical tipping thresholds without a separate observational calibration experiment
empirical ice extent must enter through a versioned observation product with missing/source flags, access date and artifact digest rather than caller-invented defaults

the fixed 340 W m^-2 legacy multiplier is acceptable only as an explicitly named reference experiment; empirical ice-albedo feedback must use radiative quantities matched to the declared albedo level/definition, such as CERES TOA or surface shortwave fields, without mixing TOA and surface semantics
empirical regional temperature series paired to sea-ice/radiation data must come from a declared gridded observation/reanalysis retrieval with coordinate/time aggregation and missingness recorded

ERA5/IFS hybrid a/b coefficients and surface pressure are source metadata; coefficients should be read from the retrieved GRIB/model-level authority or an explicitly pinned model definition, not copied into an unlabeled local table
station identifiers, locations, observation availability, quality/source flags and values must be discovered/retrieved from a maintained station authority rather than embedded station tuples
global anomaly validation and regional gridded temperature use different appropriate authorities; the projection must name which product and uncertainty/missingness semantics it uses
TOA radiative imbalance and shortwave/longwave terms are observation-product quantities and must not be synthesized from arbitrary fixed forcing constants in empirical validation
real ocean heat content/uptake weighting or validation requires a versioned observed product and its depth/time/uncertainty definition rather than arbitrary synthetic scales
